datasets.notes: NASA PGDA LRO-LOLA product 'Site07_final_adj_5mpp_surf' (NASA GSFC Planetary Geodesy Data Archive (PGDA) / LRO-LOLA); 3200x3200 px, 5.0 m/pix, float32, nodata=NaN, striped 1x3200 blocks, uncompressed, overviews=none. Product documentation: MOON_ME reference frame of DE421, south polar stereographic X/Y in metres, pixel-registered GMT convention. The product page states that about 90% of the 5 m pixels are interpolated because LOLA cross-track/inter-spot spacing leaves only about 10% direct returns; median RMS Z error is about 0.30-0.50 m and median RMS slope error about 1.5-2.5 degrees. Track geolocation uncertainty is about 10-20 cm horizontally and 2-4 cm vertically. This importer read a bounded window via HTTP range requests and cached a small derived GeoTIFF; dataset checksum is the SHA-256 of that cached window, not of the full 40.98 MB (40,980,808 bytes) product. Citation: Barker, M.K., et al. (2021), Improved LOLA Elevation Maps for South Pole Landing Sites: Error Estimates and Their Impact on Illumination Conditions, Planetary & Space Science 203, 105119, doi:10.1016/j.pss.2020.105119. Batch checksum covers canonical reference records with window checksums. Published error statistics are site/ROI dependent; not per-window uncertainty estimates. Updated checksum covers canonical derived records, including individual window checksums.

references.notes: Peak near Shackleton (LOLA Site07 roi1). ROI roi1: official https://pgda.gsfc.nasa.gov/data/LOLA_5mpp/Site07/Site07_ROIs.tgz, record 1: finite DBF X/Y, or corresponding SHP polygon bbox midpoint if DBF overflows; archive sha256:694d85297c40133e91570f020e46f7fd0b25c14e94f0a7c5b6d001e8728bddbe; fixed windows may overlap other ROI-centred windows, not independent samples. Window centre in source map coordinates: X=30167.5 m, Y=-20002.5 m. Inverse-projected centre: lon=123.546288, lat=-88.806363 (east-positive degrees; longitude is ill-conditioned this close to the pole, so the X/Y centre is authoritative). Analysis window 1980 m resampled bilinearly to 90 m; source crop 414 x 414 px at 5.0 m. window_checksum=sha256:a3803a438f4986224f9a705656e092148ab5cc5db5f774ff776104ef4c96fe34. Extractor warnings: none. The 5 m LDEM is about 90% interpolated; do not treat 5 m texture as an independent measurement. The four metrics are computed from elevation in the source projected CRS. Citation: Barker, M.K., et al. (2021), Improved LOLA Elevation Maps for South Pole Landing Sites: Error Estimates and Their Impact on Illumination Conditions, Planetary & Space Science 203, 105119, doi:10.1016/j.pss.2020.105119. Flat fraction: slope <5 degrees / valid complete Horn neighborhoods, same 90 m grid; outer rim excluded.
